IF '@{replace(pipeline().parameters.DQStatus,'''','')}' = 'Exception: Validation Failed'
select 'count' = 'default'
ELSE
IF EXISTS (select 1 from metadata.tbl_Notification with (NOLOCK) where Jobid=@{pipeline().parameters.JobId}  and ado_IsEnabled=0)
select 'Count'= 'ado_disabled'
Else
IF Exists(SELECT * from logging.tbl_Notification_current 
where  JobId = @{pipeline().parameters.JobId}  and ado_WorkItemType='Alert')
select 'Count'='ado_enabled_task'
ELSE
select 'Count'='ado_enabled_alert'

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT 
	  [jobid]
     ,srcType As SourceType
FROM [metadata].[vw_IngestionProcess]
WHERE jobid = @{pipeline().parameters.jobid}
and processStepId = @{pipeline().parameters.id}
AND IsActive=1
GROUP BY  [jobId], srcType

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT 
	vp.[jobid]
     ,vp.[priority]
FROM [metadata].[vw_ProcessSteps] vp 
join [logging].[tbl_ProcessSteps_Current] tp 
on vp.jobid=tp.jobid and vp.id=tp.id
WHERE vp.jobid = @{pipeline().parameters.jobid}
AND vp.IsActive=1 AND tp.status !='Succeeded'
GROUP BY  vp.[jobId], vp.[priority]
ORDER BY vp.[priority] ASC
